summary: Fixed three merge-gate integration defects; build, boot, and all 1,575 tests pass.

findings.description: mergePR treated a zero-exit gh pr merge command as proof that the PR landed, but GitHub can instead enqueue a merge-queue PR; it now verifies state=MERGED and mergedAt before reporting success.
The merge gate classified GitHub's neutral and skipped terminal conclusions as failures even though GitHub treats both as successful for merge requirements.

Check polling used synchronous gh queries without command timeouts, so a stalled query could exceed the configured registration and overall merge-gate deadlines; each query is now bounded by the nearest remaining deadline.
pnpm audit reports eight pre-existing advisories in Jest-only transitive dependencies (brace-expansion and js-yaml); no production dependency or session-added package is affected.
